name: shader-water
title: Water
description: Caustic light ripples across a dark water surface with gentle refraction, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: A scene wants a calm, aquatic atmosphere with gentle refracted highlights.
You need a cool, dark blue backdrop that moves slowly without pulling focus.
The brief calls for depth or flow imagery (data lakes, streaming, calm).
avoidWhen: The palette must be warm or vibrant: water reads cool by design; recolor via `color_highlight` and `color_back` or choose another shader.
You want sharp geometric motion: use shader-swirl or shader-dot-orbit.
Bright caustics would fight small text: lower `caustic` and `highlights` or use a solid backdrop.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Highlights
variables.description: Strength of the caustic highlights. There is no image to refract here, so the light needs a higher value than the original default of 0.06 to show.

variables.label: Edges
variables.description: How far the ripples reach the frame edges.

variables.label: Waves
variables.description: Strength of the slow waves that push the ripples.

variables.label: Caustic
variables.description: How much the caustics refract the surface.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
